decision: Owner and Ace, 2026-10-31: connect the existing execution model (EXEC-US-v1) to a separately versioned, capital-constrained paper account; keep PAPER_BOOK_v1 untouched as the comparison.
candidates: from paper/paper_book.jsonl: every BUY_OK plan the owner did not SKIP, plus every spike the owner confirmed BUY; considered lowest dump-tomorrow first, ties by ticker; signals from 2026-10-30

account.aggregate_includes: pending orders' planned loss + open positions' loss from the latest close to the stop plus exit cost
account.leverage: none: an order reserves shares x limit x (1 + entry cost) of free cash
account.sizing: exec_us.make_plan with equity = the account's equity at the latest close (open positions marked)

arms.BASE: exec_us.make_plan/execute unchanged: stop at the signal-session low; permitted entry = highest open with stop <= 5% away and <= signal close x 1.10
arms.FIXED5: same candidates, costs, entry print and time exit; stop set at the fill, 5% below it rounded up to the tick; permitted entry = the chase limit; sized as if filled at that limit with a 5% stop

timing: orders sealed before the entry session's regular 09:30 New York open (idxsig/calendar_us.py: NYSE holidays, daylight saving); the old 13:30 UTC cutoff of earlier records is unchanged
lifecycle: ACCT_MARK (cash, reserved, open value, equity, realized, unrealized)
definition_of_done: operational: ten consecutive candidate decisions processed end to end (tests/test_paper_account.py runs ten fixture decisions through exec_us: time exit, stop, gap through stop, per-session limit, risk limit, stop too wide, no opening print, open at or below stop, owner cancel, no plan; cash reconciles); live: the first ten real decisions
not_a_profit_test: this account checks that decisions, fills, cash and losses are recorded honestly; profit is judged later on many closed trades under a separately registered evaluation, never on a few
known_limits: daily bars: a stop and a time exit in the same session resolve stop first; no slippage beyond the stop level except gaps at the open
open prints are not fills; small caps may not fill
BASE is expected to reject most spikes (its 5% stop rule vs the spike-day low; EXEC_US_v2 demo: 79 of 113 above the permitted entry)
a held name missing from a pull is carried at cost until it returns
